scientific_choices.choice: Paper 3.2, 3.3 and 3.5 describe segmentation, component crops and PARSeq-S; these external detectors are a separate experiment.
Use the already qualified official PARSeq runtime/checkpoint, casefold and punctuation/symbol removal, care GT, exact word plus bbox IoU matching and balanced OCR confidence.

Use pretrained CRAFT via EasyOCR and DBNet/FAST via docTR detection only; no EasyOCR/docTR recognizer, scene captions or language correction. Preserve upstream detector preprocessing and configurable thresholds, without TEST fitting.

Compare zero-padding original RGB envelopes and minimum-area quadrilateral rectification. Matching always uses the detector envelope. Also choose one crop per detector region by OCR confidence and test the previously declared joint 0.6 and same-reading NMS 0.5 rule.

Sequential detector then PARSeq loading, FP32, detector batch 1, recognition batch 32, explicit CPU or single CUDA device; record stage peaks and input shapes. FAST uses docTR's inference reparameterization.

docTR pretrained training-data overlap with Total-Text is not qualified; results are exploratory checkpoint comparisons. Local bbox Hmean is not official polygon spotting Hmean. The qualified PARSeq artifact is not established as the paper's PARSeq-S.
